fields.label: Log Number
fields.description: Stable identifier for a site log. This is the key a field crew reads aloud over radio, so it must be short and must not be derived from a timestamp.

fields.label: Log Date
fields.description: When the entry was made in the field, not when it was typed up. A crew logging at 18:00 on site should not have to wait for the office to reconcile.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: Grid reference or area, e.g. 'Level 3 Grid C-F'.

fields.label: Log Type
fields.options:
Concrete Pour
Weather Delay
Subcontractor Headcount
General

fields.label: Concrete Item
fields.description: The Item consumed. Must match the item on the linked Stock Entry, or the two records describe different pours.

fields.label: Pour Volume
fields.description: Volume placed. A non-zero volume with no pour_task is refused: an unlinked pour cannot be reconciled against the WBS.

fields.label: WBS Task
fields.description: The WBS task this pour delivers. The WBS Task is the join key for progress reporting, so a pour without one is invisible to the schedule.

fields.label: Stock Entry
fields.description: The Material Issue that moved the concrete from the store to site. Reverse link, set by api/site_log when the entry is created.

fields.label: Delay Hours
fields.description: Hours lost to weather on this day. Claimable only with a reason recorded; an unexplained delay is not evidence of anything.
